Overview quest for initial adventures in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].
==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Help [[Galen Trask]] complete [[Summit Slaves|his mission]] inside Sorrow's Furnace.
* Help [[Kilroy Stonekin]] complete [[Kilroy Stonekin (quest)|his mission]] inside Sorrow's Furnace.
* Help [[High Priest Alkar]] complete [[Unspeakable, Unknowable|his mission]] inside Sorrow's Furnace.
* Help [[Orozar Highstone]] complete [[Noble Intentions|his mission]] inside Sorrow's Furnace.
* Find Galen Trask somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
* Lead Galen Trask into Sorrow's Furnace.
* Find Kilroy Stonekin somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
* Lead Kilroy Stonekin into Sorrow's Furnace.
* Find High Priest Alkar somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
* Lead High Priest Alkar into Sorrow's Furnace.
* Find Orozar Highstone somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
* Lead Orozar Highstone into Sorrow's Furnace.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest actually involves four subquests. There is no particular order in which these subquests must be completed; however, all the subquests cannot be acquired at the same time.

Starting from the [[Deldrimor War Camp]], for each of the four parts of the main "container" quest you'll have to:

* Find a dwarf in Grenth's Footprint (and probably kill a couple of [[Stone Summit]] bosses along the way; this is not difficult, but when fighting the mobs here, take out the [[Stone Summit Gnasher]]s as a priority, before they overwhelm the party with animated [[Bone Fiend]]s);
* Lead the dwarf to Sorrow's Furnace (and you can only lead one at a time);
* Speak to the dwarf within the door of Sorrow's Furnace;
* Complete the subquest that they in turn give you.

Each of these subquests must be completed before exiting Sorrow's Furnace, or you will be required to locate the relevant NPC in Grenth's Footprint again.

Each of the subquests is a [[repeatable quest]], and a good source of experience points.

For more information, see the individual entries:

* [[Summit Slaves]] (given by Galen Trask, and this one involves sub-subquests)
* [[Kilroy Stonekin (quest)|Kilroy Stonekin]] (given by Kilroy Stonekin)
* [[Unspeakable, Unknowable]] (given by High Priest Alkar)
* [[Noble Intentions]] and [[Noble Intentions Plan B]] (given by Orozar Highstone)

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Dwarven Prospector'''
:''"Grenth's Footprint is a dangerous place. Many's the traveler to these lands who left his bones by the wayside and his family wondering what became of him. There are three Dwarves and a human here who could use a well-armed escort. Will ye go and seek them out?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll look for them on the road.
| decline = I'd rather go in alone.
| ask = It's dangerous to travel alone. Why don't ye try to find those people I told you about earlier?
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
Accepting High Priest Alkar's part:
:'''High Priest Alkar''':''Come, I need to get back to my temple as soon as possible.''

Accepting Galen Trask's part:
:''"If we dress you as a slave, you'll make the perfect spy. Let's go."'' (speech bubble)
When talking to him again in Grenth's Footprint
:''"I'll wait here until you're ready."'' (speech bubble)

===Reward dialogue===
'''Dwarven Prospector'''
:''"Ye made it there and back, eh?  Excellent."''

== Notes ==
{{Anomaly|If you speak to any of the NPCs ''after'' completing their subquest, your quest log will update as if you need to complete the same subquest again. However, you can skip it and focus on the subquests that remain or proceed with [[The Final Assault]], if you have completed each of the four tasks.}} <!-- this occurs as part of the same mechanism allowing you to restart the subquests, which is sometimes necessary due to something going wrong inside the Furnace instance. -->

==Trivia==
*The reward dialogue appears to be a reference to the fictional book ''"There and Back Again"'' written by [[W:Bilbo Baggins|Bilbo Baggins]] of ''[[W:The Hobbit|The Hobbit]]'' and the ''[[W:Lord of the Rings|Lord of the Rings]]'' fame.
